upstream_preset: cfgfile.cpp default_prefs(reset, 0) + built_in_prefs(model 4, config 0, compa 0, romcheck 0) + fixup_prefs(userconfig)

sources.upstream: inherited from the upstream preset; the test proves it equals the reference
sources.pin: set by the bridge to the value upstream happens to have; a change upstream must be noticed and decided
sources.override: set by the bridge to a value that differs from upstream

fields.name: cpu_model
fields.why: 68EC020 (cpu_model 68020 with a 24-bit bus) of the A1200; the cycle-exact 68020 core (cpuemu_21, ADR 0010) is selected only by this model

fields.name: fpu_model
fields.why: no FPU on a stock A1200; without FPUEMU a line F instruction raises exception 11

fields.name: address_space_24
fields.why: 24-bit address bus of the 68EC020 the A1200 has

fields.name: cpu_compatible
fields.why: the cycle-exact 68020 core is selected with compatible mode on

fields.name: cpu_cycle_exact
fields.why: bus timing decides DMA slot stealing; the only 68020 engine compiled is the cycle-exact one (WinUAE's model: 030 timing tables, three clocks per access)

fields.name: cpu_memory_cycle_exact
fields.why: memory access timing follows the same exact model

fields.name: blitter_cycle_exact
fields.why: blitter DMA slots interleave with the CPU exactly

fields.name: m68k_speed
fields.why: 0 = original speed, not a host-throttled 'maximum'

fields.name: cpu_frequency
fields.why: 0 = derive from the video standard

fields.name: cpu_clock_multiplier
fields.why: 1024 = 2 x CYCLE_UNIT: scheduler ticks per CPU clock, the 14.19 MHz of the A1200 (set_68020_compa with cachesize 0)

fields.name: cpu_idle
fields.why: no host sleeping while the CPU is stopped

fields.name: mmu_model
fields.why: no MMU on a 68EC020

fields.name: chipset_mask
fields.why: AGA (Alice + Lisa): the A1200 chipset; 7 is CSMASK_ECS_AGNUS | CSMASK_ECS_DENISE | CSMASK_AGA, which fixup_prefs keeps only because AGA is compiled in (ports/portable/sysconfig.h)

fields.name: cs_compatible
fields.why: CP_A1200 is applied once by built_in_prefs and then cleared: with CP_A1200 every fixup_prefs would impose Gayle, IDE and PCMCIA again; with 0 it leaves the table values as they are (the PCMCIA slot is not built, and the IDE is switched on by the hard file, see cs_ide)

fields.name: cs_rtc
fields.why: the stock A1200 has no clock (config 0 has no expansion that carries one); the clock service still runs and is not seen by the machine

fields.name: cs_ide
fields.why: Gayle's IDE port is there only while a hard file is attached to it (p6_config.hdf_controller = IDE, T56: bridge/config.cpp ide_attached), so the preset has 0; upstream has IDE_A600A1200

fields.name: expansionboard[0].device_type
fields.why: upstream's table puts Gayle's IDE on the motherboard list of boards (cfgfile_compatibility_romtype follows cs_ide); the preset has none until a hard file is attached to the IDE (T56)

fields.name: cs_pcmcia
fields.why: the PCMCIA slot is not built (T56 builds the IDE port of Gayle only); upstream has 1

fields.name: cs_ksmirror_a8
fields.why: the Kickstart image is mirrored at $A80000 and $B00000 on the A1200

fields.name: cs_ciaoverlay
fields.why: without Gayle the CIA drives the ROM overlay (OVL), and the state bridge only knows that mode; upstream has 0 (the overlay is Gayle's)

fields.name: cs_ciatype[0]
fields.why: CIA 8520 of the A1200 (upstream does not select the 391078-01 of the A600)

fields.name: cs_ciatype[1]
fields.why: CIA 8520 of the A1200 (upstream does not select the 391078-01 of the A600)

fields.name: cs_eclocksync
fields.why: phase of the E clock of the A1200 CIAs

fields.name: cs_df0idhw
fields.why: DF0 answers its drive ID in hardware, as on the A1200

fields.name: cs_ciatodbug
fields.why: the A1200 table does not set the CIA TOD bug

fields.name: cs_1mchipjumper
fields.why: fixup_prefs sets it for 1 MiB Chip or more, and upstream clears it again with its trailing CP_A1200 table, which is off here; only mappings of Chip below 1 MiB read it, so it is inert but it is part of the state

fields.name: cs_cdtvcd
fields.why: no CDTV drive

fields.name: cs_cd32cd
fields.why: no CD32 drive

fields.name: chipmem.size
fields.why: 2 MiB Chip RAM of the A1200, fixed by the machine

fields.name: bogomem.size
fields.why: the A1200 has no Slow RAM

fields.name: fastmem[0].size
fields.why: no Zorro II Fast RAM

fields.name: z3fastmem[0].size
fields.why: no Zorro III RAM

fields.name: mbresmem_low.size
fields.why: no motherboard RAM

fields.name: mbresmem_high.size
fields.why: no motherboard RAM

fields.name: nr_floppies
fields.why: two internal drives; disks arrive by content id (T12)

fields.name: floppyslots[0].dfxtype
fields.why: DF0 is a 3.5 inch DD drive (0)

fields.name: floppyslots[1].dfxtype
fields.why: DF1 is a 3.5 inch DD drive (0)

fields.name: floppyslots[2].dfxtype
fields.why: DF2 absent (-1)

fields.name: floppyslots[3].dfxtype
fields.why: DF3 absent (-1)

fields.name: floppyslots[0].df
fields.why: no host path: upstream's default df0.adf is never looked up, media arrive by content id

fields.name: floppyslots[1].df
fields.why: no host path: upstream's default df1.adf is never looked up, media arrive by content id

fields.name: floppyslots[2].df
fields.why: no host path: upstream's default df2.adf is never looked up, media arrive by content id

fields.name: floppyslots[3].df
fields.why: no host path: upstream's default df3.adf is never looked up, media arrive by content id

fields.name: floppy_read_only
fields.why: every disk is write protected: the master switch of the drive code, which the reset head cannot clear

fields.name: floppy_speed
fields.why: 100 = original speed, no turbo drive

fields.name: immediate_blits
fields.why: blits take their real time

fields.name: waiting_blits
fields.why: built_in_prefs sets 1 (automatic) for every CPU from the 68020 up: the wait for the blitter would run inside the write that starts the blit, an emulation shortcut with no hardware behind it and a loop in the middle of an instruction; 0 makes the CPU run its own polling loops, as on the 68000 machines

fields.name: collision_level
fields.why: 3 = full sprite/playfield collision detection

fields.name: ntscmode
fields.why: video standard from p6_config

fields.name: seed
fields.why: random_seed folded to 32 bits (high half xor low half)

fields.name: sound_freq
fields.why: audio_rate_hz from p6_config

fields.name: sound_stereo
fields.why: stereo output (SND_STEREO)

fields.name: produce_sound
fields.why: 3 = full emulation; the delivery transport is the port's PCM queue

fields.name: sound_auto
fields.why: no host-driven audio switching

fields.name: sound_interpol
fields.why: anti-aliasing interpolation as upstream

fields.name: sound_filter
fields.why: A500 low-pass filter on

fields.name: sound_filter_type
fields.why: A1200 filter model (built_in_prefs selects it for AGA)

fields.name: start_gui
fields.why: no GUI exists

fields.name: reset_delay
fields.why: config-invariants.json: the delayed-reset wait does not poll the unit request

fields.name: crash_auto_reset
fields.why: config-invariants.json: a halted CPU stays in the polling wait

fields.name: gfx_autoresolution
fields.why: the presentation provider serves one fixed raster

fields.name: gfx_autoresolution_vga
fields.why: same; upstream default is on

fields.name: gfx_framerate
fields.why: 1 = every video unit is drawn; frame skipping would hide units

fields.name: gfx_resolution
fields.why: hires drawing: 756 columns for the PAL/NTSC beam area (docs/adr/0006-video-output.md)

fields.name: gfx_vresolution
fields.why: rows are line-doubled TV lines: 574 PAL / 484 NTSC rows

fields.name: gfx_iscanlines
fields.why: interlaced fields are woven into one buffer; the other field's rows keep their history

fields.name: gfx_pscanlines
fields.why: no scanline blanking in progressive modes

fields.name: gfx_scandoubler
fields.why: no VGA scandoubler

fields.name: leds_on_screen
fields.why: no status line drawn into the picture

fields.name: refresh_indicator
fields.why: no overlay on the picture

fields.name: input_mouse_speed
fields.why: mouse gain 100 keeps deltas exact: no fractional carry between units

fields.name: input_joymouse_speed
fields.why: joystick-as-mouse speed as upstream

fields.name: input_autofire_linecnt
fields.why: autofire period as upstream

fields.name: input_autoswitch
fields.why: port auto-switch as upstream (config-invariants.json covers its wall-clock variant)

fields.name: illegal_mem
fields.why: no illegal-access logging

fields.name: turbo_emulation
fields.why: no turbo mode

fields.name: turbo_boot
fields.why: no boot speed-up

fields.name: cachesize
fields.why: no JIT

fields.name: cpu_thread
fields.why: no CPU thread

fields.name: uaeboard
fields.why: no UAE expansion board

fields.name: socket_emu
fields.why: no host sockets

fields.name: win32_automount_drives
fields.why: no host drives

fields.name: filesys_no_uaefsdb
fields.why: no host filesystem

fields.name: parallel_demand
fields.why: no parallel port

fields.name: use_serial
fields.why: no serial port

fields.name: serial_demand
fields.why: no serial port

fields.name: picasso96_nocustom
fields.why: no RTG board

fields.name: romfile
fields.why: the firmware is the buffer of p6_load, registered under this blob id

fields.name: gfx_lores_mode
fields.why: no filtered lores line conversion

fields.name: gfx_overscanmode
fields.why: overscan mode 3: modes 0..3 give the same raster, 4..6 change its size

fields.name: gfx_xcenter
fields.why: 0: the window does not follow DIWSTRT/DIWSTOP, so the raster is guest independent

fields.name: gfx_ycenter
fields.why: 0: same for the vertical position

fields.name: gfx_extrawidth
fields.why: no extra width around the raster

fields.name: gfx_extraheight
fields.why: no extra height around the raster

fields.name: gfx_threebitcolors
fields.why: no 3-bit colour scaling (float math)

fields.name: gfx_blackerthanblack
fields.why: no blacker-than-black level

fields.name: display_calibration
fields.why: no black level calibration pass

fields.name: gfx_monitorblankdelay
fields.why: no monitor blank delay (float division)

fields.name: lightpen_crosshair
fields.why: no lightpen cursor drawn into the picture; upstream default is on and would force the auxiliary buffer

fields.name: cs_optimizations
fields.why: no chipset speed shortcuts

fields.name: cs_hvcsync
fields.why: no HV sync output emulation

fields.name: jports[0].jd[0].id
fields.why: port 0 takes the logical mouse (JSEM_MICE + 0); p6_input decides per unit whether it is used

fields.name: jports[0].jd[0].mode
fields.why: mouse in default mode

fields.name: jports[0].jd[1].id
fields.why: port 0 also takes joystick 0 (JSEM_JOYS + 0): mouse and joystick share the connector

fields.name: jports[0].jd[1].mode
fields.why: gamepad: its second and third buttons show on POTGOR (in default mode they are silent no-ops)

fields.name: jports[1].jd[0].id
fields.why: port 1 takes joystick 1; a mouse on port 1 is refused by the bridge

fields.name: jports[1].jd[0].mode
fields.why: gamepad mode, as joystick 0

fields.name: jports[1].jd[1].id
fields.why: no second device on port 1

fields.name: jports[2].jd[0].id
fields.why: ports 2 and 3 (parallel port joysticks) are not used

fields.name: jports[3].jd[0].id
fields.why: ports 2 and 3 (parallel port joysticks) are not used

fields.name: input_contact_bounce
fields.why: no random contact bounce

fields.name: input_tablet
fields.why: no tablet

fields.name: input_autoswitchleftright
fields.why: no wall-clock port auto-switch (config-invariants.json)

fields.name: input_keyboard_type
fields.why: Amiga keyboard layout of raw codes

fields.name: input_advancedmultiinput
fields.why: one event slot per input

fields.name: keyboard_mode
fields.why: CIA serial keyboard with the guest's handshake

fields.name: cs_resetwarning
fields.why: Ctrl-Amiga-Amiga resets at once, without the reset warning handshake; the A1200 table sets 1

fields.name: dongle
fields.why: no dongle

fields.name: sound_stereo_separation
fields.why: each output keeps 26/32 of its own channels and takes 6/32 of the other pair (upstream default)

fields.name: sound_mixed_stereo_delay
fields.why: no delayed crossfeed between the outputs

fields.name: sound_volume_paula
fields.why: Paula volume at full scale

fields.name: sound_volume_master
fields.why: master volume at full scale
